cd /workspace/tmp && cat > trace_scale.py << 'EOF'
import json, os, random, sys, time, pickle
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from refmodel import lpm, py_build, py_validate, mask
LOG = open('/workspace/tmp/trace.log', 'w', buffering=1)
def mark(t): LOG.write(f'{time.time()-T0:.1f}s {t}\n')
T0 = time.time()
mark('start')
rng = random.Random(4242)
routes = {}
while len(routes) < 8192:
    cls = rng.random()
    ln = rng.randrange(0, 17) if cls < 0.3 else (rng.randrange(17, 65) if cls < 0.6 else rng.randrange(65, 129))
    a = rng.randrange(1 << 128)
    k = (ln, mask(a, ln))
    if k not in routes:
        routes[k] = rng.randrange(0, 4194303)
mark('routes')
plans = []
for (ln, ma), hop in routes.items():
    plans.append(((ln, ma), ma))
qaddrs = [plans[rng.randrange(len(plans))][1] for _ in range(60000)]
qaddrs += [rng.randrange(1 << 128) for _ in range(20000)]
mark('qaddrs')
exp = [lpm(routes, a) for a in qaddrs]
mark('ref lpm live')
pickle.dump({'routes': routes, 'qaddrs': qaddrs, 'exp': exp}, open('/workspace/tmp/ctx1.pkl','wb'))
mark('pickled')
EOF
